name: Open the Eagle S replay from the home page
description: Validates that the case row on the home page opens the Eagle S replay with its 3D view loaded and the clock at the start of the window.

planSteps.description: Click the case row titled "Eagle S anchor drag" under "Case replays"
Assert the URL path is /cases/eagle-s-2024 and the page heading reads "Eagle S anchor drag"
Wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D seabed view to finish loading (the element with data-testid seabed-view has data-state ready)
Assert no error card saying "The 3D view did not load" is shown
Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "10:00 UTC" and the line under it reads "25 Dec 2024, 12:00 in Helsinki"
